requirements.text: - Education: BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
- Experience: 3+ years of software development experience, with hands-on experience building and maintaining backend systems or platform services in production environments.
- Backend Proficiency: Proficiency in backend languages and frameworks such as Python, Go, Java, or Node.js, with experience building APIs, services, and integrations.

- Data & Infrastructure Foundations: Working knowledge of databases, caching, messaging systems, and cloud-native infrastructure; comfortable contributing to systems designed for scalability, resilience, and operational efficiency.

- AI Systems Experience: Experience integrating LLM APIs, RAG pipelines, model-serving infrastructure, or agentic workflows into backend systems, with an interest in reliability, safety, and production readiness.
- Internal Platform Experience: Experience contributing to internal platforms, service frameworks, workflow engines, developer tools, or data infrastructure used by engineering or business teams.
- System Design Strength: Ability to design clear, maintainable components and participate in technical design discussions, considering performance, complexity, and developer experience.
